description: This file defines an interface for a stream consumer grain in a testing namespace, which includes methods to become a consumer, stop consuming, and retrieve the number of consumed events.

classes.name: IConsumerEventCountingGrain
classes.description: Interface for a grain that consumes stream events and counts them

methods.name: BecomeConsumer
methods.description: Starts the grain as a stream consumer for a specified stream ID and provider

methods.name: StopConsuming
methods.description: Stops the grain from consuming stream events

methods.name: GetNumberConsumed
methods.description: Retrieves the total number of stream events consumed by the grain
